let sig (r : Nat) : Nat :=
  let wires := ([(false,0,1), (false,3,9), (true,15,27), (true,17,26), (true,13,26), (true,13,27), (false,2,6), (true,1,24), (true,15,32), (true,25,32), (true,0,17), (true,0,23), (true,0,25), (false,17,19), (false,20,24), (false,39,40), (true,7,41)] : List (Bool × Nat × Nat)).foldl
    (fun (z : Nat × Nat) g =>
      let a := z.1.testBit g.2.1
      let b := z.1.testBit g.2.2
      (z.1 ||| ((if g.1 then a && b else a || b).toNat <<< z.2), z.2 + 1)) (r,26)
  wires.1 ||| ((if wires.1.testBit 32 then wires.1 else 0) <<< 43)
let Side : Type := List (Nat × Bool)
let Row : Type := Nat → Bool
let hit (s : Side) (g : Bool) (r : Row) := s.any (fun l => r l.1 && (!l.2 || g))
let push (r : Row) (v : Bool) : Row := fun i => if i = 0 then v else r (i-1)
let step (g : Bool) (r : Row) (gate : Side × Side) :=
  push r (hit gate.1 g r && hit gate.2 g r)
let initial (v : Nat) : Row := fun i => decide (i < 43) && v.testBit i
let eval (gates : List (Side × Side)) (out : Side) (v : Nat) :=
  let g := v.testBit 32
  hit out g (gates.foldl (step g) (initial v))
∀ (gates : List (Side × Side)) (out : Side),
  (∀ k, eval gates out (sig (pos k)) = true) →
  (∀ i, eval gates out (sig (neg i)) = false) → 8 ≤ gates.length
